title: Ninja Sorceress in Battle
description: A female ninja with white hair and glowing green eyes leaps dynamically through the air above a battlefield strewn with fallen armored warriors and skulls. She is surrounded by glowing green energy daggers, a swirling red and black vortex, and a red energy trail, set against a dark, stormy sky filled with red embers.
prompt: A dynamic female ninja with short white hair and glowing green eyes, wearing a dark green hooded outfit with armored gauntlets, leaps mid-air above a chaotic battlefield filled with skulls, broken armor, and fallen warriors. She summons multiple glowing green energy kunai daggers floating around her while a red energy whip trails behind. A massive swirling vortex of red and black energy dominates the background under a stormy sky with floating embers.
